title: Maria Rotilu (GP, OpenseedVC) — 'Incorruptible is a must read for every intentional builder of our time'
summary: Maria Rotilu — General Partner at OpenseedVC ('First investor in exceptional operators') — was the host of the Sept 9 Startup Leap Day Zero conversation with Eric. Publishes her recap (44 likes) as an unequivocal endorsement: she read Incorruptible before its release as prep, and expects posterity to judge it kindly.
blockquote: Eric wrote The Lean Startup, gave us language, tools, and mental models for building lean startups. I suspect his new book, Incorruptible, will do the same for founders who want to create ambitious startups that outlive them for good. I was glad to read the book before its release as part of prep for our conversation with Eric on The Startup Leap, and I believe posterity will judge this book kindly. … Incorruptible is a must read for every intentional builder of our time.
